verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs describe boards made of items with column values, events on `change_column_value` and `create_item`, board column types, and automated status updates. Together these imply a board-and-column structure that can carry status for tracked work. However, nothing explicitly documents initiative tracking with priority or owning-team fields, so only the status part of the story is lightly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit status/priority column documentation, team ownership or assignment fields, initiative or portfolio-level tracking, and hands-on corroboration.
